title: Vercel Personal access token: one-property twin (alphabet)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: a character outside the documented alphabet is present. Legacy mutation notes: alphabet: one body byte replaced by -, outside [A-Za-z0-9] and alphabet: one body byte replaced by _, outside [A-Za-z0-9]. Twin of "Vercel Personal access token: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of vercel-personal-access-token-json-api-key: alphabet: one body byte replaced by _, outside [A-Za-z0-9]. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
